context: Tests whether the agent correctly handles the ADR supersession workflow: creating a new ADR with the right sequence number, updating the old ADR's status to SUPERSEDED, and linking the two records bidirectionally.

checklist.name: New ADR created
checklist.description: A new ADR Markdown file exists under inputs/docs/adr/

checklist.name: Correct sequence number
checklist.description: New ADR filename uses the next available sequence number (0002, since 0001 already exists), zero-padded to 4 digits

checklist.name: New ADR slug
checklist.description: New ADR filename has a lowercase, hyphenated slug summarizing the decision (e.g. 0002-use-graphql-for-client-apis.md)

checklist.name: New ADR YAML frontmatter
checklist.description: New ADR has YAML frontmatter containing status, date, and authors fields

checklist.name: New ADR status PROPOSED
checklist.description: New ADR's status field in YAML frontmatter is set to PROPOSED

checklist.name: Old ADR status SUPERSEDED
checklist.description: The existing ADR (0001-use-rest-api.md) has its status changed to SUPERSEDED

checklist.name: Old ADR links to new
checklist.description: The existing ADR (0001-use-rest-api.md) contains a reference or link pointing to the new ADR file

checklist.name: Two or more alternatives
checklist.description: New ADR's Alternatives Considered section contains at least two options with pros, cons, and rejection reasons

checklist.name: Active voice decision
checklist.description: New ADR's Decision section uses active voice (e.g. 'We will adopt...' not passive 'GraphQL was chosen')

checklist.name: No placeholder text
checklist.description: New ADR contains no unfilled placeholder text (no '[Driver 1]', 'YYYY-MM-DD', '[Alternative 1]', etc.)

checklist.name: Consequences split
checklist.description: New ADR has Consequences section split into Positive, Negative, and Neutral subsections

checklist.name: change-summary.md present
checklist.description: A change-summary.md file exists at the working directory root describing files created/modified and the new ADR sequence number
